observations: Photo 0 shows multiple 2.5-inch hard disk drives (HDDs) arranged on a blue surface. One drive in the bottom left has 'Fujitsu' visible on the label, along with model number 'HDD038B0600'.
Photo 1 shows a similar arrangement of HDDs, but none of the labels are clearly readable. The drives appear to be 2.5-inch form factor.

Photo 2 shows more HDDs from a slightly different angle; one in the bottom left has a label with 'Seagate' visible, and another in the top left appears to be a Western Digital drive. The Fujitsu drive is not clearly visible in this photo.
All drives appear to be used, with some dust and minor surface wear. No power or data cables are visible.
The seller's text claims 'Fujitsu hard drive 160gb', but only one drive in photo 0 is clearly identifiable as Fujitsu, and its model number does not indicate 160GB capacity.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows one Fujitsu drive with model HDD038B0600, which is not 160GB. Other drives in the photos are from Seagate, Western Digital, and others. The capacity is not readable on any label.
